text:
Priya Nair: Hey team — we got the completed SIG questionnaire from Meridian Health, deadline EOW Friday to return with evidence. Link: https://secure.example.com/sig/meridian. Need q-by-q artifacts for controls around encryption (3.2), key rotation (4.1), VPC/private deployment (6.1), and SOC2 attestation. Can eng/security own the control answers?
Marco Rivera: I can take the encryption bits (3.2) and draft config snippets for Dedicated + Private. Do we need both TLS and at-rest details?
Alice Chen: I'll own key rotation (4.1) and the VPC/network controls (6.1). Please drop the KMS rotation policy and the last rotation timestamp. Also need who has access to rotation keys.
Sam Ortega: Meridian asked specifically about log retention and where audit logs live — I have the SOC2 report (2024-09) and the logging retention policy PDF. I'll attach.
Priya Nair: Great — Evan from product will confirm default retention. Evan Liu: Default app logs retained 90 days in hosted; for Dedicated/Private can be configured up to 7 years. I'll paste the console path where teams can set this.
Priya Nair: @Alice @Marco can you both produce 1-2-line evidence snippets we can paste back into the SIG spreadsheet, and upload the supporting PDFs to the portal? Meridian expects links, not just text.
Marco Rivera: Draft for 3.2: "All in-transit traffic is TLS1.3 between client and Redwood inference gateway; inter-service traffic uses mTLS with cert rotation via internal CA. See config excerpt and packet capture sample." Attaching config snippet: ```yaml
server_tls: TLS1.3
mtls: enabled
cert_rotation: automated (30d)
```
Alice Chen: Draft for 4.1 and 6.1: "KMS-backed keys managed in customer or Redwood KMS depending on deployment. Rotation schedule: 90 days for customer-managed, 180 days for Redwood-managed; access limited to KMS-admin role with MFA enforced. Private deployments support HSM integrations." I'll upload the KMS rotation policy and role mapping (redacted).
Jordan (sig-bot): Uploaded artifact: SOC2-Redwood-2024-09.pdf (link: https://artifacts.internal/soc2/Redwood-2024-09.pdf) :white_check_mark:
Sam Ortega: Thanks Jordan. Priya — Meridian also asked for an architecture diagram showing flow for Private deploy in their region (eu-west). Do we have a regional diagram?
Evan Liu: I have a simplified eu-west private deployment diagram; will drop in the artifacts folder as `eu-west-private-arch-v1.png`.
Priya Nair: Team, can we confirm data residency statement for Private: "Customer data stored in customer VPC/region; no Redwood-hosted backups by default" — is that accurate to assert?
Alice Chen: That's correct for Private. For Dedicated (Redwood-managed), backups are stored in the region unless customer requests cross-region replication. I'll include the backup policy doc.
Marco Rivera: Uploaded config snippet for KV cache and prefix caching as evidence for performance controls (control 8.4). Link: https://artifacts.internal/configs/kv-cache-snippet.txt
Priya Nair: Awesome. Next steps: Alice — upload KMS policy + role mapping. Marco — upload TLS/mTLS configs and the packet capture redact. Evan — upload eu-west diagram and retention path. Sam — attach SOC2 and logging policy. I'll assemble the spreadsheet answers and run a quick review tomorrow morning.
Alice Chen: On it. ETA: 10am PT tomorrow.
Marco Rivera: I'll have my artifacts posted by EOD today.
Sam Ortega: SOC2 + logging policy uploaded. Link: https://artifacts.internal/meridian/sales/soc2-logging.zip
Priya Nair: Perfect — thanks all. Ping me if Meridian pushes for a live walkthrough; I can coordinate a 30m call. :slightly_smiling_face:
